# Repo-owned sol2 snapshot

This source is a snapshot of [ThePhD/sol2](https://github.com/ThePhD/sol2) at commit `336f76c3772c84e347a7f4ffb246d8c0e2d5f426`, the exact gitlink previously recorded by Enroth Continuum. On 2026-11-07, all 669 original tracked files were copied from a clean local checkout at that commit and verified against its Git blob IDs without source edits.

The original MIT `LICENSE.txt` and bundled license inventory in `documentation/source/licenses.rst` are retained. This provenance note is Enroth Continuum metadata, not part of the original snapshot. The Mac build consumes this directory through `thirdparty/CMakeLists.txt` as an interface library with optional sol2 tests, examples, documentation and Lua-source fetch paths disabled; other dependencies remain external until migrated separately.
